staging.about: M1-84 (doc 24 §5 optional moment CH01-MUGS-NAMED, M3-99 PR_Mug_Named): at the end of EX-CH01-S12 the four nameless mugs of EX-CH01-S01 gain masking tape and the cadets' names, and keep them for the rest of the game (the CH04-S12 echo; CS-17's five named mugs). The layer shows once the moment is in story_log.moments (CampaignRoom.set_story_choices(choices, moments)); each mug stands where it stood, its name facing the commons. Front row from the commons side, west to east: KAI, AMARA; back row: MEI, RAFI (role order, as the CH07-S01 observation cards). Ferreira's fifth mug is not part of this moment.

From 12 Dec 2046 Ferreira lives at Aurora: four seats become five (doc 09 LOC-01) and the fifth mug joins the four (doc 24 §1.1). Her chair is at the head of the table until she gives it up in EX-CH07-S01 (doc 24 §2.7); from EX-CH07-S02 it stands among the cadets' chairs on the east side (M3-7R).
Doc 24 §5.2 D9: after EX-CH05-S05 Ferreira leaves one 2034 record at her place, under her mug, through Chapters 6-7.

staging.about: Chapter 7 in the Commons. The local network diagnostic (M3-7A) on the north wall by the main display: all paths pass in S01 while Rao confirms the labelled source live; the exposed radio branch isolated from S05; in S09 Earth does not answer (S08 -> S09) while the local network still carries voices and garden data; from S10 the branch tests read local pass, dish and feedthrough fail, the data card is out with the saved relay-bypass diagram (S09 -> S10) and the exposed-branch fault label hangs under the cabinet (doc 09 'CH07 exposed-branch fault label'). The main display shows the Earth desk (S01), the outside-clearance readings (S09) and the stable care board (S10).

staging.about: EX-CH07-S12 'Who Stays With the Garden' (7 Apr to 8 Apr 00:00). EN_Garage (rover bay, departure boards; M3-4A) is not built yet, so the scene uses the Commons, where the roster puts all five: the main display becomes the two destination boards (the rover team and the home team) and the rover loadout stands on a table by the airlock door. Packed: the spare controller Kai labelled on the bench and the spare battery (S11 -> S12: the packed equipment and the route), three road-repeater cases under the table, three helmets, the three-site route card and the duplicate route and shelter checklists dated 8 Apr 00:00 (CH07 -> CH08). The small guide light is in the plan.
